verdicts.summary: The steer rejection at Orchestrator.ts:3963 is correct after a successful Stop, but thread.stop can record the stop on a run whose interrupt was never sent. The live agent then refuses steers it would have received.
verdicts.scenario: 1) A running run R is the thread's target. 2) thread.stop is dispatched. dispatchRunInterrupt (9617 path, called at 9758) fails before emitting or enqueuing anything, for example a transient projection or policy error at 9243 or 9580-9587. 3) The Exit failure is only logged (9780-9784). interruptEffects is discarded (9772-9776 merges only on success), so no provider-turn.interrupt is ever sent and the agent keeps running. 4) The reached map still contains R (9790-9791), so markStoppedRun writes a run_interrupt_request for R (8858-8908). 5) The user sends an explicit steer or restart to R. stopReachedRun at 3963 returns true and the steer fails with 'is stopping and cannot be steered'. Before this commit the steer was accepted and the live agent received it.
verdicts.consequence: After a failed Stop, the run keeps working but explicit steers are refused, and plain sends are queued behind it (see note 1). The stop itself never reached the provider, so nothing ends the run early. Only the non-session failure cases differ: a session lookup failure at 9539 would already fail the steer at 3992-4001.

verdicts.summary: The plain-send downgrade at Orchestrator.ts:4820-4826 is correct when the stop reached the provider. It is wrong for the failed thread.stop case above: a plain send to a live agent is queued and releases the hold, when it could have been steered in.
verdicts.scenario: Same start as note 0: thread.stop on running run R fails before the interrupt effect is enqueued, and markStoppedRun still records run_interrupt_request for R. The client then sends a plain 'auto' message. resolveMessageDispatchIntent yields steer_active targeting R, and stopReachedRun at 4823 is true. The message is downgraded to queue_after_active. It is then queued behind R, and the held queue is released at 5046-5063. The agent is still live and would have accepted the steer.
verdicts.consequence: The message waits in the queue until R finishes on its own, and the held queue then starts. It is not lost. The 'agent never receives this text' premise in the note does not hold in this failure case.
